items.title: SonicOS SSLVPN认证绕过致MFA失效
items.summary_zh: 持有备用认证方式有效凭据者可绕过SAML认证与MFA，远程登录SSLVPN获取内网访问权限
items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.action_zh: 升级至SonicWall修复版本；临时禁用SSLVPN或强制SAML+MFA校验
items.repro_note: 需具备备用认证方式的有效凭据，向SSLVPN登录接口提交以绕过SAML
items.impact_scope: 边界SSL VPN设备，常暴露公网
items.description: An authentication enforcement vulnerability in SonicOS SSLVPN service may allow a user with valid credentials for an alternate authentication method to bypass SAML authentication controls. Successful exploitation may also bypass SAML-enforced multi-factor authentication (MFA).

items.title: Entra设备注册IDOR越权提权
items.summary_zh: 远程未授权攻击者通过用户可控键值绕过授权校验，在设备注册中提升至更高权限
items.affected: Microsoft(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.action_zh: 关注微软官方补丁，收紧设备注册授权策略并最小化权限
items.repro_note: 构造携带他人可控键值的设备注册请求，需有效租户环境
items.impact_scope: 云身份平台，多租户身份体系
items.description: Authorization bypass through user-controlled key in Entra Device Registration allows an unauthorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network.

items.title: Tracecat SAML断言未验签绕过
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者向暴露的SAML ACS端点提交伪造未签名响应，冒用已知邮箱用户会话
items.action_zh: 升级修复版本；在代理层限制SAML ACS端点访问来源
items.repro_note: 向SAML ACS端点提交未签名断言，需已知目标用户邮箱
items.description: An unauthenticated attacker who can reach the SAML assertion consumer endpoint can submit a forged unsigned response for an existing Tracecat user email address and obtain that user’s session. Exploitation does not create users when SAML user creation is disabled and does not affect default Fargate or Helm deployments.

items.title: SQL仪表盘变量替换SQL注入
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者向公开或嵌入图表的URL筛选参数注入，可读取或篡改后端数据库
items.action_zh: 升级至5.2.1以上；避免对外公开嵌入式图表
items.repro_note: 向公开/嵌入图表的URL筛选参数注入，需后端存有SQL查询
items.impact_scope: 内网BI看板，数据库可被读取
items.description: Prior to 5.2.1, SQL dashboard-variable substitution used attacker-controlled JavaScript replacement strings unsafely across SQL connectors and separately failed to escape backslashes for MySQL and MariaDB quoted contexts. An unauthenticated user sends crafted URL filter values to a public or embedded chart backed by a stored SQL query.

items.title: 2FAuth认证绕过可创建管理员
items.summary_zh: 未认证远程客户端可在全新实例上创建管理员，或冒用已知账号劫持邮件重置
items.action_zh: 升级至厂商修复版本，限制实例暴露并核查异常管理员账号
items.repro_note: 未授权调用注册与邮件相关接口，全新实例可直接建管理员
items.impact_scope: 自建2FA管理应用，存有二次验证密钥
items.description: 2FAuth is a web app to manage Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) accounts and generate their security codes. An unauthenticated remote client can therefore create an administrator on a fresh instance or impersonate and redirect email for a known account, exposing 2FA secrets and administrative functions.

items.title: 2FAuth认证绕过致账号接管
items.summary_zh: 未认证远程攻击者可绕过认证逻辑，获取2FAuth账户及其二次验证密钥的访问权限
items.action_zh: 升级至厂商修复版本；限制实例公网暴露并轮换2FA密钥
items.repro_note: 未授权访问认证相关接口；官方公告未披露具体参数
items.impact_scope: 自建2FA管理Web应用，密钥敏感
items.description: 2FAuth is a web app to manage Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) accounts and generate their security codes. Prior to 8.0.0, when AUTHENTICATION_GUARD=reverse-proxy-guard is enabled, ReverseProxyGuard::user() reads the default REMOTE_USER identity header, or a custom identity header selected by the AUTH_PROXY_HEADER_FOR_USER configuration setting, without confirming that the request originated from a configured trusted proxy.

items.title: JWT默认密钥可伪造令牌绕过认证
items.title_zh: JWT默认密钥可伪造令牌绕过认证
items.summary_zh: 攻击者利用默认弱CB_SECRET签发HS256令牌，冒充任意用户调用API与Socket接口
items.action_zh: 更换强随机CB_SECRET并升级修复版本，排查异常令牌
items.repro_note: 用默认CB_SECRET签发HS256令牌，uid指向目标用户
items.description: The vulnerable surface is session JWT fallback in server/modules/verifyToken.js, verifyUser.js, getUserFromToken.js, and socketManager.js across the API and socket layer. A stock source or repository Docker Compose deployment retains a known, weak, or default CB_SECRET and an attacker submits a forged HS256 token decoding to a target user id.

items.title: 无人机地面站3334端口未认证接管
items.title_zh: 无人机地面站3334端口未认证接管
items.summary_zh: 网络可达3334端口的未认证攻击者直接取得已认证会话，下发指令并上传航线
items.action_zh: 升级修复版本；限制3334端口访问并启用TLS与认证
items.repro_note: 直连目标3334端口（默认无TLS），无需凭据即可取得会话
items.impact_scope: 无人机地面控制服务，默认监听全网卡
items.description: UgCS server before 6.2 contains an authentication bypass in the HCI protocol login handler (LoginHandler) exposed on TCP port 3334. Because the service listens on all interfaces (0.0.0.0) without TLS by default, an unauthenticated remote attacker with network access to port 3334 can obtain an authenticated session without knowing any credential and then issue privileged commands, including commanding connected drones and uploading flight routes.
